days.title: North Island Exploration and Culture
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Grieben
stops.detail: Grieben is the oldest, northernmost and smallest village on Hiddensee and lies on the eastern edge of the island's highlands.

stops.name: Gerhart-Hauptmann-Haus
stops.detail: Today, Kloster, with the Gerhart Hauptmann House, the island church and the island cemetery containing the graves of Gerhart Hauptmann, Walter Felsenstein and Gret Palucca, is considered the cultural center of Hiddensee.

stops.name: Dornbusch
stops.detail: It is located directly on the highlands, the highest elevation of which is the Dornbusch.

days.driving: Allow time between these sights; local travel times are not verified and conditions vary.

days.title: Central Village Sights and South Hiddensee
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Hexenhaus
stops.detail: The oldest still preserved house on the island, the "Hexenhaus" (formerly the summer house of Adolf Reichwein), stands in Vitte.

stops.name: Schwarze Mühle
stops.detail: In addition, the (probably last) tent cinema, the Seebühne Hiddensee (puppet theater) and a Dutch windmill, the "Black Mill," are located in Vitte.

stops.name: Neuendorf
stops.detail: Neuendorf is the southernmost place on Hiddensee.
